content: OpenVLA-OFT uses num_open_loop_steps to control action-chunk replay length; quick-start sets it to NUM_ACTIONS_CHUNK (full open-loop replay of the 8-step chunk, no re-inference until exhausted). LIBERO eval script is experiments/robot/libero/run_libero_eval.py with GenerateConfig; get_vla_action() returns the chunk for sequential execution.
